**Fausto Rodríguez Zapata** Postdoc.  
Fausto studies maize glycerolipid quantitative and population genetics and genetic associations with soil variables involved in phosphorus deficiency.  
</a>  <a href="https://github.com/faustovrz">
<i class="fa fa-github-alt" aria-hidden="true"></i>
</a>

**Jill Love** Postdoc.  
Jill joined the lab in 2026.

**Nirwan Tandukar** Postdoc.  
Nirwan joined the lab in January 2022 as a PhD student, completed his PhD in July 2026 and is now a postdoc in the lab. He develops approaches that use multiple genetic datasets to identify genes involved in adaptation to abiotic stresses, and built the [Sorghum Lipid Database](https://nirwan.shinyapps.io/SAP-Lipidomics-Database/).   

**Pascual Blanco** Field Technician.  
Pascual joined the lab in fall 2021. He manages all our field operations.

**Lina López-Corona** Project Manager, ARPA-E NSave Maize project.  
Lina joined the lab in fall 2023.  

**Carolina Escalona-Weldt** Lab Manager/Technician.  
Carolina joined the lab in summer 2024.

**Hannah Pil** PhD Candidate, Genetics Program.   
Hannah joined the lab in summer 2021 as an undergraduate and since then [she has become a master corn pollinator](https://photos.app.goo.gl/B7gZ5gMczcBoPXcG6).

**Zehta Fazler** PhD Student, Genetics Program.     
Zehta joined the lab in December 2024. She is working on the genetic mechanisms that drive cold stress tolerance, with an emphasis on evolutionary diversity in maize.

**Lauren Insko** PhD Student, Structural and Molecular Biochemistry Program.     
Lauren joined the lab in January 2025. She is working on identifying regulatory elements of the gene *High PhosphatidylCholine 1* as well as identifying structural elements of the phospholipase protein product.  

**Brock Davis** Undergraduate Researcher, Genetics major.  
Brock joined the lab in 2025.

**Sanaa Jain** Undergraduate Researcher, Biochemistry major.  
Sanaa joined the lab in 2026 through the SAPLINGs program.

**Maheera Hassan** Undergraduate Researcher, Genetics major.  
Maheera joined the lab in 2026.

**Sam Strimple** Undergraduate Researcher, Genetics major.  
Sam joined the lab in 2026.
